text: Galileo Galilei's Dialogo sopra i due massimi sistemi del mondo was published between June 1631 and February 1632, in a first printing of one thousand copies. The printing sold out before the end of September, when the Pope banned the book and the Inquisition officially suppressed it in 1633. In 1633 Galileo was convicted of grave suspicion of heresy, and the Dialogo was placed on the Index of Forbidden Books, from which it was not removed until 1835.
meta_description: Galileo's Dialogo sopra i due massimi sistemi del mondo was banned by the Pope and suppressed by the Inquisition in 1633, and stayed on the Index until 1835.
